research_assessment_note: The exact four-element diamond rank polynomial is assessed against derivation-module, unit-conjugacy, zero-product and radical-square-zero results. Publication priority remains best of knowledge. This text is scientific evidence, not an external certification.

value.rationale: The four-element diamond is the smallest branching two-path incidence algebra with nonzero J², so its all-q adjoint rank spectrum isolates the first failure of the radical-square-zero graphic-matroid regime. The six exact centralizer strata and full rank-five locus are a natural complete invariant that can test future generalizations to height-three incidence rings and detect two-step interval interactions. This is a bounded, self-contained canonical exact fact and not a claim of a broad general theorem; the finite verification alone is not its significance.
